profiles.position: Chief Minister of Penang; Member of the Dewan Rakyat
profiles.description: Chow Kon Yeow represents Batu Kawan, Pulau Pinang, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Chief Minister of Penang; Member of the Dewan Rakyat. A DAP member.

milestones.title: Provide university study assistance to three Air Putih students
milestones.description: Lim Guan Eng presented three university-bound students with RM1,000 each.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers this documented handover in his Air Putih state-assembly role. It is not a Bagan-wide university-support score. No earlier public promise was established; the date is the published delivery report.

milestones.title: Build the Mengkuang Park Water Treatment Plant
milestones.description: Chow described PBAPP’s RM250 million water-treatment plant as part of Penang’s water contingency programme.
milestones.progress_note: 35% is the published physical-progress snapshot on 9 May 2026, not a November measurement. A 4 June PBAPP release uses an end-2026 completion schedule, superseding the earlier November forecast. Completed handover was not verified.

milestones.title: Develop the Perak–Penang water supply project for supply beginning in 2032
milestones.description: Chow described the conditional bulk-water agreement as a route to an additional long-term supply for Penang.
milestones.progress_note: Signing is documented, but execution remains subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals and infrastructure development. It is not proof that water is already flowing. The year-end target is a year-only planning marker.

methodology: Editorial records of dated public commitments, documented activities and delivery reports. Evidence-only activities and deliveries have no invented earlier promise URL or promise date. Status and numerical progress refer to the dated evidence, not a live performance rating. Joint government, constituency, party and agency roles are identified. Unknown outcomes remain NULL. Additional research may extend the initial pass.
